📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
This is occurrence #165 in the last 7 days.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)
Playbook: Confirm shape (monitor is one of 5 team:crm AMQP-consumer siblings) -> pull DD metric sum:trace.amqp.command.hits over a multi-hour window, expect a genuine brief dip below the monitor's floor -> confirm 0 status:error logs -> check sibling monitors -> escalate only if still open past ~1h or a sibling co-fires.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_status: monitoring-noise-suspected-unconfirmed

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded cycle (no Slack MCP; DD monitor scan diff, monitor 302055141 fired 2026-09-02T05:47:21Z)

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-07-notifications-p95-latency-monitor-noise`
This is occurrence #44 in the last 7 days.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@customer-management` / `#team-customer-management`)
Playbook: Re-query p95:trace.aspnet.request{service:notifications,env:prod} over the monitor's own last_10m window plus a wider surrounding window -- expect values in the 0.001-0.2s range, nowhere near 1s. Confirm 0 status:error logs. Not user-impacting -- escalate only if a genuine (non-single-bucket-artifact) elevated p95 is ever observed.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_status: monitoring-noise-suspected-unconfirmed
